rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１５Ah... sorry to drop in like￥this. Do you have a minute?
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１６I just can't accept the results￥of this last exam...
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１７When you saw your scores this￥time, didn't you feel anything?
I did my best, my way.
Nothing in particular.
I did my best, my way.
Nothing in particular.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１８Hmm...￥I see. So you were￥working hard...
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０１９I see... Then am I the only￥one who thinks something's off?
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０２０I'm an expert, after all.￥I didn't think you could pass me￥that easily...
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０２１Don't tell me... you used the￥facilities after hours without￥permission to train?
Like I'd ever do that!
Think what you want.
I would never do that!
Think whatever you like.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０２２But anyone can deny it￥as much as they want!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０２３Because I can't think of any￥other explanation.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０２４No matter how I look at it,￥there's no way you could pass an￥expert that easily.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０２５Sorry, but I have my doubts￥about these results.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８４＿０２６Whatever happens on the next￥exam, I won't lose to you.＝＠０８４＿０２７Remember that.￥Well then...
